summary: The persistent connect retry timeout defaults to 15 seconds; raise ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_CONNECT_RETRY_TIMEOUT or connect_retry_timeout, keeping it above the SSH timeout and below connect_timeout.
questions: How do I fix connect retry timeout expired?
What should connect_retry_timeout be set to?

answer_card.title: Increase connect retry timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_CONNECT_RETRY_TIMEOUT=30
```
```ini
[persistent_connection]
connect_retry_timeout = 30
```
Default 15 seconds. Keep it **greater** than the SSH timeout (`[defaults] timeout`) and **less** than `connect_timeout`.
